visible_turns.text: Guess what came in the mail today ?
Freshman orientation is the last week of august , but I want to go two weeks before that to get settled in .
Yes . I ’ ll be very busy ! I have to get a visa , buy a plane ticket , and pack my things . But first , I want to register for classes .
Well , they sent me their prospectus , so I can start looking now . do you want to help me decide which classed to take ?
Well , I have to take all the fundamental course , plus a few from my major .
I hope to major in English literature , but the admissions counselor told me that many people change their major many times in their first year , so we ’ ll see .
In order to graduate , every student must take a certain amount of classes in history , math , English , philosophy , science and art .
Yes , it is . It ’ s also very different from the British education system .
oh , sure . In British , students don ’ t have to take the foundation course .
maybe because they think they know everything already ! ha ha .
